label: GitHub → Slack
info: WorldFixture runs GitHub and Slack inside this demo. Click Run workflow. The flow discovers a repository and channel, reads open issues, posts a Slack summary, and reads that exact message back. Open Debug to inspect the receipt. Each click posts one new synthetic message. No real provider account is used.

name: GitHub: list repositories

Slack: post summary
Slack: read message back
Verify message content
func:
if (!(msg.statusCode >= 200 && msg.statusCode < 300) || msg.payload?.ok === false) throw new Error('Provider request failed: HTTP ' + msg.statusCode);
const message = msg.payload.messages?.find(m => m.ts === msg.posted.ts); if (message?.text !== msg.summary) throw new Error('Slack read-back did not match'); msg.payload = {ok:true, workflow:'GitHub → Slack', repository:msg.repository, openIssuesOnPage:msg.issueCount, channel:msg.posted.channel, timestamp:msg.posted.ts, text:message.text}; flow.set('lastResult', msg.payload); delete msg.headers; delete msg.url; return msg;

name: Record failure
func: msg.payload = {ok:false, error:msg.error.message}; flow.set('lastResult', msg.payload); delete msg.headers; return msg;

label: Notion → GitHub
info: WorldFixture runs Notion and GitHub inside this demo. Click Run workflow. The flow discovers a Notion page, reads its blocks, creates a GitHub issue from that content, then reads the issue back. Open Debug to inspect the receipt. Each click creates one new synthetic issue. The page and repository are discovered from the running providers.

if (!(msg.statusCode >= 200 && msg.statusCode < 300) || msg.payload?.ok === false) throw new Error('Provider request failed: HTTP ' + msg.statusCode);
if (msg.payload.title !== msg.issueTitle || msg.payload.body !== msg.issueBody) throw new Error('GitHub read-back did not match'); msg.payload = {ok:true, workflow:'Notion → GitHub', sourcePage:msg.pageId, title:msg.pageTitle, repository:msg.repository, issueNumber:msg.issueNumber, copiedCharacters:msg.pageContent.length}; flow.set('lastResult', msg.payload); delete msg.headers; delete msg.url; return msg;
